programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Nu när Allisons speciella förmågor har avslöjats för allmänheten har allas liv vänds upp och ner.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison försöker hjälpa utredaren Cynthia Keener att hitta en försvunnen tonårsflicka. Samtidigt drömmer Ariel om Allisons gymnasietid från 80-talet.
programme.sub-title: But for the Grace of God

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Joe tar med sig en motvillig Allison till en fest hos en potentiell arbetsgivare. Senare försvinner arbetsgivarens dotter, vilket får Allison att koppla sina senaste drömmar om Paris till försvinnandet.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: En ung döv flicka kidnappas, vilket får Allison att helt förlora sin hörsel. Med Allison i obestånd bestämmer sig Joe för att hjälpa henne och Cynthia Keener att utreda kidnappningen.
programme.sub-title: Do You Hear What I Hear?

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Larry Watt, en försvarsadvokat som har orsakat problem i Allisons förflutna, ber Allison att bli konsult åt honom. Allison har ont om pengar och accepterar hans erbjudande.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Devalos försöker återta åklagarmyndighetens kontor. Allisons stöd för Devalos sätts på prov när hon får syner av senator Jed Garrity, Devalos starkaste politiska anhängare, som är inblandad i en konspiration.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Joes mamma gör ett överraskande besök, vilket oroar Allison eftersom hon inte har sett henne sedan hennes psykiska förmågor blev allmänt kända.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison försöker hitta kopplingen mellan Ariels förutsägelse om en klasskamrats mors död, drömmar som rör hennes fall med Cynthia och Devalos mordfall.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Medan Allison arbetar med att hitta en försvunnen lokal flicka får hon reda på hemligheter från Cynthia Keeners förflutna.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har visioner om att en vän till Scanlon och Lynn DiNovi dör i ett olyckshändelse i hemmet. Detta får henne att koppla ihop några nyligen inträffade "oavsiktliga" dödsfall, vilket sätter hennes egen hälsa i fara.
programme.sub-title: A Cure for What Ails You

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison träffar Meghan Doyle, Joes nya affärspartner. Samtidigt slutar hennes gamla bil att fungera och Joe överraskar henne med en snygg begagnad bil.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har drömmar som hjälper Scanlon i hans sökande efter vem som dödade en rik lokal knarklangare. Allison och Scanlon blir förbluffade när Allisons drömmar leder dem till en svårt funktionshindrad man.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison försöker hjälpa ett ungt par som tror att det spökar i deras hus, men hennes ansträngningar resulterar i ett mord. Samtidigt försöker Meghan Doyle sälja sin kontrollerande andel i Joes uppfinning.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Ett chockerande och brutalt slut väntar Allison och Cynthia när de fördjupar sig i det tio år gamla fallet med kidnappningen och mordet på Cynthias dotter.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison och Scanlon samarbetar för att spåra upp den farliga "puma" som de tror är ansvarig för morden på unga män, men hon får också visioner om att Devalos kampanj är i fara.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: När Joe presenterar sin nya solenergibaserade uppfinning för ett investeringsföretag väcker han intresse hos riskkapitalisten Meghan Doyle.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer om ett spelprogram som kan upptäcka lögner och när hon vaknar hör hon en signal i huvudet när någon ljuger för henne.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison misstänker att en försvunnen kvinna kan vara ett offer för hennes märkliga barn. Samtidigt dyker Joes syster Sarah upp oannonserat.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison vaknar upp fem år i det förflutna efter att hon och Devalos skjutits ner av en främmande man. I det förflutna berättar Allisons drömmar för henne att Devalos kommer att döma en oskyldig man för mord.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: En man vid namn Lucas Harvey förföljer Allison, övertygad om att han gör Guds verk genom att göra sig av med henne och hennes förmåga.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Loren's sister, Miss Olive, has died and bequeathed her cattle to Matthew who, along with Dr. Mike, Sully, Colleen, Brian, Loren, Robert E, and Grace, attempts to bring the cattle back to a ranch near Colorado Springs.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: The Cattle Drive continues with various difficulties to overcome, including conflicts between Matthew and Sully, cattle rustlers, hungry Indians, and a prairie fire. Dr. Mike delivers a calf, and Sully helps her clean up afterwards.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Elizabeth sends crates of books from Michaela's deceased father's collection, prompting her to open a public library. Many become alarmed at the content of some of the books and want to prevent people from reading them.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Brian rescues a man from a trap who has horrific burns to his face from a train crash. Michaela decides to perform reconstructive surgery to repair his face.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Cloud Dancing and the rest of the Cheyenne are told to move to a reservation where they would be dependent on handouts. Dr. Mike, Sully, and the children head to Washington to lodge a complaint and get the order changed.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Arriving in Washington, Dr. Mike and Sully find it difficult to find anyone to listen to their concerns. Sully is arrested for army desertion, while a plot against the president is overheard. Michaela must break Sully out of jail to expose the conspiracy.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: When money becomes short for Sully, he tries everything to make ends meet rather than accept help from Dr. Mike.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Dr. Mike and Sully are traveling through dangerous Indian country when their stagecoach is robbed, and they are abandoned.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Dr. Mike discovers a lump in Dorothy's breast and tries to convince her to have surgery. Hank tries Ladies Night at the saloon, and Jake and Loren have a plan to get free drinks. Colleen deals with hurtful boyish pranks from classmates.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Dr. Mike has a hard time accepting Dorothy's decision not to have the surgery that will save her life. Jake tries to escape the two men who kidnapped him.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: The town's Christmas spirit is in question when a family who are Jewish immigrants moves to town.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Sully is appointed Indian agent to the Cheyenne and approaches it in an idealistic fashion. When the food intended for the tribe is diverted and illegal alcohol is plentiful, Sully becomes angry.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: A newspaper report of a comet's imminent collision with Earth causes hysteria in town over the end of the world.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Sam Lindsay, an older independent woman, decides to end her medical treatment and take off into the wilderness.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Colleen and Brian's biological father Ethan returns to town with a new wife, intending to take the children away from Dr. Quinn.
programme.sub-title: Cooper Vs Quinn, Medicine Woman, Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Colleen and Brian run away to keep their father from taking them away from Dr. Mike and Sully. After they are found, it's discovered Colleen has developed pneumonia. Dr. Mike realizes she has to let them go to save them.
programme.sub-title: Cooper Vs Quinn, Medicine Woman, Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: The town puts on a production of Romeo and Juliet. Brian tries to learn what love is so he can write a paper for school.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Dr. Mike convinces Robert E to take a job fixing a train boiler, then finds out it is a dangerous job.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Ett blodprov visar att Blake är Fallons riktiga far. Steven reser till Hollywood för att leta efter sin fru. Claudia får veta att hennes man och dotter tros vara döda.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Claudia läggs in på sjukhus efter skottlossningen. Krystle är inblandad. Logan Rhinewood fortsätter att samla ihop Devner-Carrington. Cecil friar till Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Claudia är förvirrad efter olyckan. Jeff uppmanar Fallon att försonas; Steven blir utpressad av en ung luffare.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Steven arresteras. Alexis och Cecil planerar att gifta sig. Fallon berättar för Nick att det är slut mellan dem. Claudia tror att Fallons barn är hennes nu avlidna dotter Lindsay.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Farouk, en oljeman från Mellanöstern som är angelägen om att hämnas på Blake, berättar för Nick att Carrington är ansvarig för hans brors död. Nick attackerar Blake, som lämnas medvetslös på botten av en djup ravin.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle hittar Blake i bergen och tar honom till sjukhuset. Nick Toscanni försvinner. Cecil förs också till sjukhuset och han är mycket svag. En polisutredning inleds för att hitta barnet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Michael åker till Denver för att ta reda på vem han är. Alexis och Cecil planerar ett bröllop på sjukhuset. Claudia försvinner och Blake misstänker henne för att ha kidnappat barnet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Barnet återfinns hos den riktiga kidnapparen, Alfred Grimes, och det visar sig att han är far till Roger Grimes. Fallon avskedar Susan. Claudia åker till ett sanatorium. Fallon börjar leta efter ett jobb.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Cecil överlåter sin egendom och Colbyco till Jeff och Alexis. Han avslöjar också sitt "Rhinewood"-spel för Blake vid uppläsningen av hans testamente. Blake misstänker Alexis för att vara delaktig i det.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis ger sin nyfunna, sedan länge försvunna son Adam ett jobb på Colbyco. Blake börjar tro att Adam faktiskt kan vara hans riktiga son. Fallon och Adam fortsätter att flirta med varandra.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake försöker bli vän med Adam, men Adam avvisar honom. Alexis berättar för Mark att han fortfarande är gift med Krystle. Mark försöker få ett jobb som tennisproffs på Fallons hotell.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Josephs dotter Kirby kommer att bo hos Carringtons efter att ha gjort slut med sin fästman i Frankrike. Joseph försöker övertala henne att återvända till honom. Mark får jobb på Fallons hotell.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Fallon får ett brev från Steven och det visar sig att han är på en oljerigg i Javasjön i Indonesien. Adam blandar den giftiga medlet i färgen till Jeffs nya kontor.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Jeff börjar bli yr och påverkad av den giftiga färgen som Adam använde på sitt kontor. Joseph säger till Kirby att hålla sig borta från Jeff.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Familjen Carrington informeras om att Stevens oljerigg exploderat. Blake beger sig ut för att leta efter honom, med en oinbjuden Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis och Blake fortsätter sökandet efter Steven i Idonesien, men hittar bevis för att Steven kan vara död. Blake vägrar att tro på det och anlitar ett medium, Jason Denner, för att hjälpa honom.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Tillbaka i Denver fortsätter Blake sitt desperata sökande efter Steven med hjälp av synska Jason Dehner. Blake vägrar att tro att hans son är död och Krystle är orolig för hans oberäkneliga beteende.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A school teacher terrifies parents with her ability to inspire talents within students. Meanwhile, Richard and Lily are confronted by police, and Jordan warns Shawn not to overuse his healing gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Edwin Mayuya, a 4400 who has the ability is to heal damaged fetal chromosomes while in utero. Unfortunately, it turns out this man is responsible for the slaughter of an entire clinic.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC follows a series of clues that lead them to Jordan Collier's killer. Tom faces a difficult choice when he must choose between the law or his family.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: 4400s across the world are coming down with strange and life threatening illnesses. Tom and Diana learn a horrible secret that the government may have directly caused the illnesses of the 4400s.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Discovering that NTAC is behind the disease plaguing the 4400s, Tom and Diana try to get to the bottom of NTAC's cover-up, while Kyle considers turning himself in.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana, with the help of Gary Navarro, try to track down T.J Kim, a 4400 whose ability they believe caused a man to stab Dennis Ryland. Richard and Lily are forced to deal with a now grown Isabelle.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro is arrested after attempting to assassinate Dennis Ryland. Isabelle attempts suicide in the hope of saving her mother, but fails when she survives a fall from the roof of the 4400 Center.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: T.J. Kim is murdered, and Tom is accused of committing the murder. Shawn and Isabelle grow closer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for someone who is kidnapping young 4400s. Shawn is threatened by the Nova Group.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: While in one of Alana's fantasies, Tom and Alana see Maia, though they have no memory of her existence. Diana's life is threatened, and Tom brokers a deal with the future to set history straight.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle seeks revenge on the Nova Group after they attack Shawn. Alana confronts the man responsible for killing her husband and son in a car accident nine years ago.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: With Dennis Ryland's help, NTAC tracks down the remaining members of the Nova Group. Nikki pays Shawn an unexpected visit.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santanico returns with a new secret - and a potential new ally - leading the Geckos to Lord Venganza, who is hiding out in a bloody culebra prison.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: The Geckos pursue Amaru to a mysterious Western town, where she plans to reclaim her true form and open the gates of hell.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Season three of "From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series" continues the Gecko brothers' saga as they fight their way through the chilling world of culebras, the vampire-snake hybrids that control hidden empires in Texas and Mexico.

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En överraskande eliminering skakar om husen. Paren dyker djupare in i experimentet. Vissa partners inser att de kommer allt längre från varandra.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny överraskning skakar om båda villorna. Great och Nafeesah fördjupar sin relation, medan Hall drar en slutsats som förändrar allt. Marisela hittar tillbaka till sig själv när skulden börjar hinna ikapp Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Temptation Light är en ständig påminnelse att det inte finns några hemligheter på ön och att alla aktioner har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det är dags för videomeddelanden, och Mark avslöjar ännu en twist. Även singlarna får nu skicka videomeddelanden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren hanterar efterspelet efter videomeddelandena. Nya relationer växer sig starkare och blir intimare. Andra deltagare kämpar med skuldkänslor och osäkerheten på hur allt ska sluta.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren beger sig på övernattningsdejter med deras favoritsinglar. Nya romanser blossar upp, kärleksförklaringar och framtidsplaner görs upp. En till person ger efter för frestelsen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren Marisela & Christopher och Vanessa & Robert återförenas för deras sista Lägereld. Var deras relationer tillräckligt starka för att överleva Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall och Paris & Great återförenas för sin sista Lägereld. Lägereldarna är bra på att reda ut saker och avslöja sanningar, även när sanningen har varit en lögn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren och singlarna har återförenas under 90-minuter för att se tillbaka på sin tid på ön.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En timme av material som aldrig tidigare visats.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fyra par beger sig till Temptation Island för att se om de är menade för varandra.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlarna flyttar in och det börjar gå vilt till. Vid den första Lägerelden uppstår smärtsamma uppvaknanden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Några par börjar njuta av sin nyfunna självständighet, medan andra är fast i det förflutna.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Spänningarna ökar i villorna. Linjerna suddas ut vid kvällens temafest.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Mark levererar en oväntad twist vid utslagningen, vilket skakar om båda villorna.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lasting Impression
programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body and a tiny wad of chewing gum found near the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Metal Business
programme.desc: Doctors cannot pinpoint the source of a businessman's illness.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clutch of Witnesses
programme.desc: Two eyewitnesses may hold the key to the death of a motorcycle gang member.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Tight Leash
programme.desc: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Danger
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun. However, he had an alibi for the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John "Jack" Boyle in the disappearance of his wife, Noreen, when he signs mortgage papers for a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find Noreen's body in the basement of Dr. Boyle's new house.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within a Hair
programme.desc: In 1996, Indiana police identified Richard Alexander as the “River Park Rapist” who assaulted four women that year. Later, DNA analysis casts doubt on his conviction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dew Process
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open and reveal the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: On a windy Kansas night in 1995, a mysterious fire swept through the home of a prominent doctor. In the debris, investigators found evidence which told them how the fire started.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her infant son, the obvious suspect is the husband and father of the victims. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story of passion gone wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Bond
programme.desc: Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: Mark Fair left for work and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead. During the autopsy, bite marks on her body were re-examined and forensic odontology identified the killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 2: Moons
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.
programme.sub-title: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Da Heidi får et interview til et 'drømmejob', der får hende til at overveje at droppe skolen, indser Lauren, at hun og Heidi er på vej i forskellige retninger.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren væk på et ærinde til New York, og da hun vender tilbage til L.A. venter der en stor overraskelse fra hendes fortid. Heidi indser, at arbejdet som festarrangør ikke er en stor fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skynder sig hjem fra et Teen Vogue-event for at være sammen med Jason på hans fødselsdag, men aftenen går ikke som forventet. Audrina beder om Heidis råd til hendes seneste date med model/skuespiller Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason bliver en stor distraktion i Laurens professionelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig sin store chance for at arbejde på natklubberne, men den kunne ikke være kommet på et værre tidspunkt.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er slængets første ferie i L.A., men ikke alle får, hvad de har ønsket sig. Lauren får svært ved at få et nytårskys, da hun får et uventet opkald fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gøre Laurens 20 års fødselsdag speciel, men da hun lyver om at arbejde med mandlige modeller til en opgave for Teen Vogue, bliver deres forhold sat på prøve.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi beslutter omsider, at hun har haft nok drama med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tænker på at tage tingene videre til det næste niveau.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Da Laurens hårde arbejde til modeugen i L.A. fører til en alle tiders karrieremulighed, er hun splittet mellem sit job og sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Da en ikke inviteret Audrina dukker op til Heidis fødselsdag, finder hun ud af, at Heidi ikke er parat til at tilgive og glemme. Lauren vil fokusere på sit arbejde, men falder for den charmerende nye fyr i sit liv, Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina fortæller Heidi om Spencers utroskab, men Heidi tvivler - indtil hun ser det selv. Lauren tvivler stadig på, om hun er parat til et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi holder en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mere end hun havde håbet på. Lauren skal planlægge en middag for Teen Vogue, men ryger i baggrunden til fordel for superpraktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: Da Lauren fortæller Heidi, hvad hun virkelig mener om Spencer, må Heidi vælge mellem sin bedste veninde og sin kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren indser, at hun ikke kan stole på sine bedste venner, efter Heidi fører Jen og Brody sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer beder Heidi flytte ind med ham, men Heidi ved ikke, hvad hun skal gøre, eller hvordan hun skal fortælle det til sin bofælle Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21. Fødselsdag er fuld af overraskelser, da Heidi og Audrina holder en fest for hende. Jen prøver at slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fylder 21 og Heidi har store planer for fødselsdagsfesten. Men inden festen beslutter Heidi, det er tid til at fortælle Lauren om Spencers idé om at flytte sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Everyone Falls
programme.desc: Med udsigt til et nyt job, falder Whitney over sin største mulighed med Teen Vogue. Spencer går for vidt, da han presser Heidi til at forlade Lauren og flytte ind med ham.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen tilspidses tingene, da Heidi beslutter at flytte ind med Spencer. Lauren vil have Audrina til at fylde tomrummet efter hendes bedste veninde, og Whitney flyver til New York til et interview.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går ikke til Heidi and Spencers housewarming fordi Heidi har spredt rygter om hende. Så da Lauren løber ind i Heidi har de et kæmpe skænderi.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi bliver endnu mere uvenner da Spencer frier til Heidi. Audrina finder sammen med en ekskæreste og Lauren vender hjem til Laguna Beach for at få et godt råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at hjælpe Audrina med at beslutte om Justin har kærestekvalitet, men Audrina har allerede truffet sin beslutning. Heidi finder ud af, at det ikke er lutter lagkage at være forlovet.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Ifølge mig: et komisk twist på din yndlings reality-serie. Fra Lauren til Spencer og alle de andre, intet bitchy look eller bromance udelades af skuespilleren, der spilleralle de medvirkende.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis sociale omgangskreds krymper da Spencer 'slår op' med Brody fordi han har hængt ud med Lauren. Audrina vil være fast kæreste med Justin, men det nægter han at gå med til.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren bliver ringet op af en ekskæreste. Heidi konkurrerer med sin kollega Elodie om at blive forfremmet på arbejdet.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens følelser for Jason blusser op, men da de løber ind i Heidi og Spencer på en restaurant går bølgerne højt. Heidis forfremmelse hos Bolthouse koster hendes venskab med Elodie.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren bliver chokeret da hun hører, at Jason har en kæreste, men Jason har en endnu større overraskelse oppe i ærmet. Heidi finder ud af at Spencer ikke har fortalt sine forældre om deres bryllupsplaner.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Hele slænget fejrer Brodys fødselsdag i Vegas. Audrinas kæreste Justin skaber splid i venskabet med Lauren. Lauren og Brodys tiltrækkes mere og mere af hinanden.

programme.title: The Hills: What Goes Around
programme.desc: Jen Bunney fortæller Lauren, at Brody startede rygterne om hende, mens Brody siger, at det var Spencer, hvilket bringer Heidi i en svær situation.

programme.title: The Hills: No More Mr. Nice Guy
programme.desc: Lauren indleder et nyt forhold med en model, men indser, at hun stadig har følelser for Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Stress And The City
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren tager en tur til New York NYC for Teen Vogue og Spencer kontakter Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Young Hollywood
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren er til Young Hollywood Party og Heidi fejrer sin 21. fødselsdag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi og Lauren skændes endnu engang offentligt, hvilket får Heidi til at undskylde for alt det, der er sket. Og der er problemer i Audrina og Justins forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leger Kirsten Giftekniv, da Whitney skal ud på sin første date med deres personlige træner. Og Spencer modsætter sig Heidis ønsker om et eventyrbryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina ser Justin kysse med en anden pige, hvilket fører til endnu et kæmpeskænderi. Heidi er chokeret, da Stephanie skændes med Lauren og Brody på en natklub.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror, at Brody måske er for meget playboy for hende. Spencers søster fortæller hende, at Heidi er i tvivl om deres bryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: As One Door Closes Another One Opens
programme.desc: En af drengene bliver sendt hjem, og det efterlader pigerne med tårer i øjnene. Det bliver for meget for en af de originale 8, og Sophie har muligvis mødt sin drømmemand. Får David en chance til?
programme.sub-title: As One Door Closes Another One Opens

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale
programme.desc: Joey får sit livs chok, da en eks gør en spektakulær entré til den store finale, og Georgia bliver følelsesladet, men får hun sin lykkelige slutning med de andre par?

programme.desc: Otte sexede singler opdager, at deres drøm om sommerkærlighed bliver et mareridt, når flere ekser end nogensinder kommer for at skabe kaos. Zahida kæmper med Maisie om Sean, men når den første eks kommer, bliver det et værre blodbad.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Sea Of Tears

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Love Triangle

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Nicole's Nightmare
programme.desc: Spændingerne i villaen når kogepunktet, da Zaralena får Zahidas vrede at føle. Den nye eks får fyrene til at føre sig territorialt. Josh har et godt øje til Nicole, men slutter det, da hun opdager en knusende hemmelighed?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Heartache
programme.desc: Terrortabletten gør livet surt for Becca. Harriettes hjertesorg bliver værre, og Zaralenas elendighed fortsætter, men det er den nyeste eks, der truer med at skabe det værste kaos.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth Comes Out
programme.desc: Ankomsten af endnu en eks fører til et blodbad i villaen. Nicole må høre sandheden om Jacques Fraser, mens Ross og Harriette skændes igen. Og Zaralena tager en stor beslutning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får omsider sin straf. Det nyeste ekser stormer stranden og villaen, skaber splid mellem Sean og Zahida og skaber kaos for resten.

programme.desc: Terrortabletten holder et stort græsk bryllup for Sean og Zahida, men da den sidste eks kommer, bliver festen kaotisk. Harriette får en chokerende besked af Ross.

programme.desc: Michael Goonans hemmelige mission røbes i Hemligskuret, men giver hans åbenmundethed bagslag? En eks giver Kori og Ella problemer, og KC får grønt lys af Kaz.

programme.desc: Michael Goonan sender en hjem og tænker så over sin egen tid i villaen. KC har stadig svært ved at omgås Theo mens Kaz er i villaen, og Nathan siger farvel til eks'en Tommy og byder så næste eks velkommen på stranden.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem og Alexis presses til bristepunktet, da Alivia og Keith udforsker, om de er et perfekt par. Ekser kommer med afsløringer, inklusive en eks, der allerede ved besked.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One
programme.desc: Vært Terrence J giver os et eksklusivt kig på denne sæsons medvirkende i AYTO og afslører, hvorfor de 22 singler er elendige til forhold.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 2
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Leap of Fate
programme.desc: 22 singler tager springet og flytter ind i et hus på Hawaii for at prøve at finde 11 perfekte par og vinde en million dollar. Jalousi spreder sig, når par dannes hurtigt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak provokerer Bria, når han flirter med andre kvinder, og hele huset bliver inddraget i dramaet. Tevin og Kenyas letsindige opførsel truer deres spirande forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak udforsker sine muligheder, mens kvinderne slås om hans opmærksomhed. Kenya og Jasmine bliver officielt fjender.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name
programme.desc: Asia bliver såret, når hun finder ud af, hvad hendes ven og fyren, hun er vild med, gjorde bag hendes ryg. Cali og Bretts spirende romance bringes i fare af deres dårlige vaner.
programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset bliver rystet, da deres ekser dukker op for at få noget kvalitetstid. Bølgerne går højt, når en eks truer med at splitte et stærkt par ad. Zak er splittet mellem Bria og Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi starter drama, da han afslører, hvad Tevin og Jasmine gjorde natten før. Bria bliver sur over Morgan og Zaks forhold. Huset tager nogle risikable parvalg.
